    ☀️ Golias¶

    [!INFO] The Sun of Ge'or — A256 A — Yellow Dwarf G1V Official star name you gave: Golias. The light Ge'or orbits. Not the Sun of Old Earth — a brighter, slightly more massive yellow dwarf that puts Ge'or at 1.26 AU on its 520-Earth-day year.

    ⭐ Classification¶

    G1V yellow dwarf — one step hotter and more luminous than Sol (G2V). Appears white-yellow at noon, casts a clean Silver Bride shadow band.

    Parameter Value Sun for scale
    Spectral class G1V Sun G2V
    Mass 1.08 M⊙ 1.00
    Radius 1.10 R⊙ 1.00
    Luminosity 1.55 L⊙ 1.00
    Effective temp 5,880 K 5,778 K
    Metallicity [Fe/H] +0.05 0.00
    Surface gravity log g 4.42 4.44

    Why this and not a Sun twin? Ge'or year = 480 Ge'or days at 26h = 520 Earth days = 1.42 Earth years. Kepler forces a = 1.26 AU around a Sun-mass star. At 1.26 AU a Sun-twin gives only 0.63× Earth flux — equilibrium -45°C, not 14°C. 1.55 L⊙ restores Earth-like flux at 1.26 AU (flux = L/a² = 1.55/1.59 ≈ 0.97× Earth). This lets Leonidas be Venus-hot at 0.72 AU and Mib stay breathable at 1.65 AU, as you described. Alternate canon (if you prefer a stricter Sun-twin): keep G2V 1.00 L⊙ and explain 14°C via thicker greenhouse — both valid; this file latches the brighter G1V as primary.

    ⏳ Age¶

    ~4.7 billion years — middle-aged main sequence.

    • Lifetime estimate: ~7.0 Gyr total (t_MS ≈ 10 Gyr × M/L = 10 × 1.08/1.55). At 4.7 Gyr, Golias is ~67% through main sequence — stable for another ~2.3 Gyr.
    • Formation: ~4.7 Gyr ago from a slightly metal-rich cloud (+0.05 dex) — explains 10 planets + Ge'or's 1.37× size + gas giant abundance.
    • For context: The Last Great War lasted 3M years and Final Push / Glorious Alliance crash was ~40k Ge'or years (56k Earth years) ago — an eyeblink on stellar time. Golias was already 4.7 Gyr old then; it has shone unchanged since the Hybrian campfire ~6000 BCE on Old Earth.
    • Error bar: ±0.5 Gyr (4.2–5.2 Gyr all consistent). Younger than 4.0 Gyr would be unusually active (flares); older than 5.5 Gyr would be dimming off main sequence — neither matches Ge'or's stable climate.

    Determined from habitable-zone width + planet count + Ge'or's stable 14°C mean. Not measured in-story — estimated from orbital physics.

    🌗 Habitable Zone¶

    Conservative: 1.08–1.52 AU · Optimistic: 0.95–1.67 AU

    • Leonidas 0.72 AU — inside inner edge → Venus-like, scorched, as you gave.
    • Ge'or 1.26 AU — center of HZ → 1.37× super-Earth, 14°C mean, 19.8° tilt, 26h day, 1.26 AU flux ≈ Earth.
    • Mib 1.65 AU — outer edge, barely in optimistic zone → thin cold but O₂ + water can persist with greenhouse, 2 moons help tides.

    🪐 System¶

    Ten planets, official name A256. Inner 3 rocky/breathable, then giants, then the captured rogue Sinnichi (huge rocky frozen past giants — formed in interstellar space, captured by Golias), then outer giants and Cinzars.

    See [[A256/index|A256 System]] for full table. Trade Routes distances on Ge'or remain measured: 1 Ge'or year = 520 Earth days.
